question: Find the value of ((453 times 453 times 453 - 383 times 383 times 383))/((453 times 383 + 383 times 383 + 453 times 453))
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The given expression follows the exact algebraic identity pattern: (a³ − b³) / (a² + ab + b²).

This structure directly simplifies to (a − b).

Here, a = 453 and b = 383.

Result = 453 − 383 = 70.

**∴ The correct answer is 70.**
